text: BulkPublish for DeepSeek Harness 是一个 DSH 网页端插件，通过 Cordis bundle 将 MCP 服务地址加入配置，并在运行时读取 API 密钥，再注册 streamable-http MCP 客户端。连接后可在 DSH 对话中调用服务端提供的社交媒体工具，用于起草、安排和发布帖子，管理媒体与渠道，以及查看分析和处理收件箱、评论。适合希望从 DSH 对话中管理多个社交渠道的用户；使用前需要 BulkPublish API 密钥，密钥通过环境变量提供并作为 Bearer token 发送到 MCP 服务。

BulkPublish for DeepSeek Harness connects DSH to an MCP service and registers a streamable HTTP client. Its tools support social posts, channels, media, analytics, inbox conversations and comments. A BulkPublish API key is required and sent as a bearer token.
想在 DSH 对话里连接一个社交媒体管理 MCP 服务。
如何让 DSH 调用工具来安排和发布社交平台帖子？
I want to manage social posts and channels through MCP tools in DSH chat.
BulkPublish for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「连接 MCP 服务」：插件组合服务地址、HTTP 传输方式和 Bearer 密钥生成客户端配置，并注册到 DSH；连接后，对话可调用服务端工具。
BulkPublish for DeepSeek Harness 使用前须知：需设置 BULKPUBLISH_API_KEY；密钥作为 Bearer token 发往 mcp.bulkpublish.com。未设置时插件不会注册客户端。

dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · Introduction：

BulkPublish for DeepSeek Harness

bulkpublish.com · MCP server docs · npm

dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · What it does：`dsh-plugin-bulkpublish` connects DeepSeek Harness (dsh) to the [BulkPublish](https://www.bulkpublish.com) MCP server at `https://mcp.bulkpublish.com`. Once it is installed, the model can draft, schedule, publish and analyse social media posts, upload and browse media, and work through inbox conversations and post comments, all from a dsh chat.

dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · What it does：The plugin's `apply(ctx, config)` loads DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` as a child plugin with a `streamable-http` transport. BulkPublish tools then appear to the model as `mcp__bulkpublish__<tool>`.

dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · Supported platforms (15)：Facebook · Instagram · X/Twitter · TikTok · YouTube · Threads · Bluesky · Pinterest · Google Business Profile · LinkedIn · Mastodon · Discord · Telegram · Tumblr · Snapchat

dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · Setup：1. Create a BulkPublish account at [bulkpublish.com](https://www.bulkpublish.com) and connect the channels you want to post to.
2. Get an API key from the **Developer** dashboard: [app.bulkpublish.com/developer](https://app.bulkpublish.com/developer). Keys start with `bp_`.
3. Export it before you start dsh:

```sh
   export BULKPUBLISH_API_KEY=bp_your_key_here
   ```

dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · Setup：Authentication uses a BulkPublish API key sent as a bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`). The key is read from the environment at runtime. It is not written into your profile or shipped with this package. If no key is set, the plugin logs a warning and registers no tools.

dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-bulkpublish
```

From source:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:bulkpublish/dsh-plugin-bulkpublish
```

The bundle inserts this entry into your profile (`cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: bulkpublish
  name: 'dsh-plugin-bulkpublish'
  config:
    url: 'https://mcp.bulkpublish.com'

dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · Install：Optional config: `apiKeyEnv` (env var name, default `BULKPUBLISH_API_KEY`), `serverName` (tool namespace, default `bulkpublish`), `toolCallTimeoutMs` (default `60000`).

dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · Example prompts：- "List my connected channels and tell me which ones need reconnecting."
- "Draft a LinkedIn and X post announcing our spring sale, and schedule it for the next free queue slot."
- "Upload https://example.com/banner.png and schedule an Instagram post with it for Friday at 10:00."
- "Show me last month's analytics broken down by platform."
- "Retry the failed platforms on yesterday's post."
- "Show the unread inbox conversations and draft replies for me to review."

dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · Tools：| Area | Tools |
|---|---|
| Posts | `create_post`, `update_post`, `get_post`, `list_posts`, `delete_post`, `publish_post`, `retry_post`, `get_queue_slot` |
| Approval | `approve_post`, `reject_post` |
| Channels | `list_channels`, `get_channel_options`, `update_channel` |
| Media | `upload_media`, `list_media`, `create_media_upload`, `finalize_media_upload` |
| Labels | `list_labels` |
| Analytics | `get_analytics`, `get_post_metrics` |
| Inbox | `list_conversations`, `get_conversation`, `reply_to_conversation`, `update_conversation` |
| Comments | `list_post_comments`, `reply_to_comment`, `moderate_comment` |
| Interactive views | `compose_post`, `view_posts`, `view_channels`, `view_media`, `view_analytics` |
dsh-plugin-bulkpublish README · Tools：Publishing, replies and comment moderation act on your real accounts right away. Review what the model proposes before you approve those calls.
